Name: Orbotron Upgrades (v0.15 Update)
Description:
Expands Orbotron functionality with additional abilities, jobs, and progression options.

This is a Stardeus v0.15 compatibility update of the original Orbotron mod. The goal of this release is to preserve the original functionality and gameplay while restoring compatibilitywith current versions of Stardeus.

[h2]Compatibility updates include:[/h2]
• Stardeus v0.15 schema and definition updates
• Converted deprecated Core file overrides to modern JSON patching methods
• Updated species type definitions for compatibility with current game systems
• Updated Orbotron starting job configuration for compatibility with current game systems
• Removed deprecated definitions and validation warnings where possible
• General compatibility, stability, and maintenance improvements

[h2]Original mod:[/h2]
 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3318634071 

Full credit for the original mod belongs to the original author. This upload exists solely to provide continued compatibility with current versions ofStardeus after the original mod became outdated.

If the original author returns and publishes an official update, I will gladly defer to their version.

Game Version: v0.15.x
Mod Version: 2.1.0

[h2]2.1.0 — selected-mind recovery[/h2]
Select an active player-owned Orbotron mind and use Restore jobs to review and add only missing configured jobs. Existing learned skills and priorities are preserved. New capable skills start at level 1; new public jobs start off. Native restrictions remain. Make a separate save before applying recovery. Tested on Stardeus v0.15.0-rc335.3217, including existing-mind recovery and save/load with preserved skills and priorities. Recovery is disabled on unreviewed Core builds until compatibility is checked. See README.md and CHANGELOG.md for requirements, recovery limits and release details.
